### Fixes

- stop WebGL terminals from drawing colored glyph fragments and blank rows after an atlas page merge: addon-webgl 0.19 merges atlas pages while a frame is still writing its rows, so rows written earlier in that frame keep the old page and position and are drawn wrong until something redraws the whole terminal (a selection, a tab switch); its merge flag is set once and never reset, so nothing redoes the frame. A Vite transform ports the 0.20 beta fix: a layout counter each glyph renderer tracks, a rebuild of every row and texture when the layout changed mid-frame, and clearing a shared atlas now tells its other terminals ([4f83e0d6](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/4f83e0d6792c059ff173275a12d895b913516a7c))
